summary.description: Ampace lists the JP30 family as a 3.0Ah 18650 cell and distinguishes maximum continuous full-discharge current from its higher temperature-limited maximum. Battery Mooch tested the exact JP30P1 revision and estimated 36A true continuous current; 56A is temperature-limited. A current Japanese vape retailer lists the exact flat-top JP30 for electronic-cigarette and vape use. Keep JP30P1 separate from LT 19660A and other rewraps; pulse claims are not continuous ratings. This record preserves exact-model evidence and unresolved revision caveats for the canonical catalog entry.
